summary: KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC filed an 8-K solely to disclose its monthly Transactional Net Asset Values per share for ten share classes as of April 30, 2026, ranging from $34.18 to $37.19. This is a routine price-setting announcement used for sales and repurchases of its shares, with no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event involved. The filing contains no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no merger-related mechanics. It is a standard periodic NAV disclosure. No special-situation categorization applies.
